div.l: In ȝouthe he hadde lernyd a good mystir
He was a wol good wryȝte a carpenter
This reue sat vp on a ful good stot
That was a pomeli grey ⁊and hyȝte skot
A long surcote of pers vp on he hadde
And bi hese syde he bar a rusty blade
Of norfolke was þis reue of whiche I telle
Be syde a toun men clepe baldiswelle
Tukkede he was as is a frere aboute
And euere he rod þᵉ hemereste of oure route
A somnour was þere with vs in that plaseA Somenour
That hadde a fer red cherubynys face
For sausefleme he was with eyen narwe
As hot he was ⁊and lecherous as a sparwe
With skalede browys blake ⁊and pilid berd
Of hese vesage chylderyn weryn a ferid
Ther nas quyk siluyr litarge ne bronston
Boras seruse ne oyle of tartre non
Ne oynement þat wolde clense ⁊and byte
That hym myȝte helpyn of hese whelkys white
Ne of the knobbis sittynge on hese schekes
Wel louede he garlek onyounnys ⁊and ek lekys
And for to drynkyn strong wyn red as blod
Thanne wolde he speke ⁊and crye as he were wod
And whan he wel dronkyn hadde þe wyn
Thanne wolde he speke no word but latyn
A fewe termys hadde he to or thre
That he hadde lernyd out of sum decre
No wondir he herde it al the day
And ek ȝe knowe wel that a Iay
Kan clepe watte as wel as can the pope
But who so couthe in oþere þyngis hym grope
Thanne hadde he spent al hese philosophie
Ay questio quod Iurys wolde he crye
He was a gentil harlot ⁊and a kynde
A betere felawe schulde men not fynnde
